name: factory-agent-tools
description: Deterministic agent tools shipped by the Autonomous Product & Software Factory (factory.aichieve.net): 2026 US self-employment, Section 199A QBI, and quarterly estimated-tax calculations (QuarterLine), and Stripe payout -> GL reconciliation (LedgerLink).

tool_selector.note: Name of the tool to invoke; must be one of the tools listed below. Omit for the default.

auth.note: Optional Stripe customer id for $0.25/query metered billing.

tools.name: calculate_qbi_deduction
tools.description: Calculates the exact 2026 Section 199A QBI deduction under enacted law (OBBBA Pub. L. 119-21 at 20% rate, Rev. Proc. 2025-32 thresholds $201,750/$403,500, and SSTB/W-2/UBIA limits).

isSstb.description: Whether the business is a Specified Service Trade or Business (law, health, consulting, financial services, etc.).

w2WagesPaidByBusiness.description: W-2 wages paid by the business to employees for W-2/UBIA limitation.

ubia.description: Unadjusted basis immediately after acquisition of qualified business property.

otherTaxableIncome.description: Other taxable income impacting overall taxable income threshold.

tools.name: calculate_quarterly_estimate
tools.description: Computes 2026 self-employment tax, progressive income tax, and quarterly estimated tax installments with safe-harbor protection (highlighting Q3 Sept 15 deadline).

priorYearAgi.description: 2025 Prior-year Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) for safe-harbor calculation.

priorYearTax.description: 2025 Prior-year total tax liability for safe-harbor rule (100% or 110%).

w2Wages.description: W-2 wages received (reduces available Social Security $184,500 wage base).

age.description: Age of taxpayer (evaluates $6,000 OBBBA senior deduction if 65+).

isTippedOccupation.description: Flag for tipped occupation under OBBBA 'No Tax on Tips'.

qualifiedTips.description: Qualified tips eligible for up to $25k deduction.

tools.name: reconcile_stripe_payout
tools.description: Reconciles a netted Stripe payout into categorized GL journal lines that sum to the payout net exactly (Σ net == payout.amount). Accepts a customer read-only Stripe restricted key or a pasted Stripe JSON export; never uses the factory account.

account_id.description: Stripe account id whose payout is being reconciled.

period.description: Payout period, e.g. '2026-08' or a Stripe created range 'start:end'.

payout_id.description: Optional specific Stripe payout id to reconcile.

stripe_restricted_key.description: Customer read-only Stripe restricted key (rk_…). Required unless export_json is supplied.

export_json.description: Pasted/uploaded Stripe JSON export (payout + balance_transactions). Required unless stripe_restricted_key is supplied.
